name: 33436 · Boynton Beach, FL
findings: ZIP 33436 (Boynton Beach) has 94 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33436 (Boynton Beach) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33436 (Boynton Beach) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 30% of the typical level).
